# Ignis AI Labs

> Engineering and AI studio. We build production routing software, warehouse management systems (WMS), ERP, and customs/logistics automation for manufacturing plants, warehouses, and logistics operators across India and worldwide. We provide both ready-built core products and custom engineering integrated with SAP, Oracle, Zoho, and legacy databases.

- Website: https://ignisailabs.com
- Full Documentation for LLMs: https://ignisailabs.com/llms-full.txt
- Service Area: India and worldwide
- Contact: contact@ignisailabs.com

## Core Software Products

- [Production Routing Chart (PRC)](https://ignisailabs.com/solutions/production-routing-chart): Digital routing and traveler card software for composites, fiber moulding, and multi-stage manufacturing plants. Plain markdown: https://ignisailabs.com/solutions/production-routing-chart.md
- [Warehouse Management System (WMS)](https://ignisailabs.com/solutions/warehouse-management-system): Real-time bin-level stock tracking, barcode/RFID directed picking, and ERP synchronization for plants and distribution centers. Plain markdown: https://ignisailabs.com/solutions/warehouse-management-system.md
- [ERP for Manufacturers](https://ignisailabs.com/solutions/erp-for-manufacturers): Modular ERP covering raw material inventory, multi-level bills of materials (BOM), production routing, and financial ledgers. Plain markdown: https://ignisailabs.com/solutions/erp-for-manufacturers.md
- [Logistics & Customs Software](https://ignisailabs.com/solutions/logistics-software): Export document automation (commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates) and multi-carrier container tracking. Plain markdown: https://ignisailabs.com/solutions/logistics-software.md

## Engineering & Integration Services

- [SAP & System Integration](https://ignisailabs.com/services/sap-and-system-integration): Bi-directional RFC, BAPI, and REST connectors syncing plant floor tablets and WMS with SAP S/4HANA, ECC, Oracle, Zoho, and Tally. Plain markdown: https://ignisailabs.com/services/sap-and-system-integration.md
- [AI & Automation for Manufacturing](https://ignisailabs.com/services/ai-automation-for-manufacturing): Document OCR for vendor packing lists, vision inspection interfaces, and automated shift scheduling. Plain markdown: https://ignisailabs.com/services/ai-automation-for-manufacturing.md
- [Custom Software for Factories](https://ignisailabs.com/services/custom-software-for-factories): Bespoke web, mobile, and rugged tablet applications tailored to specific plant layouts and shop floor constraints. Plain markdown: https://ignisailabs.com/services/custom-software-for-factories.md

## Industry Specialization

- [Composites & Fiber Moulding](https://ignisailabs.com/industries/composites-and-fiber-moulding): Stage-by-stage traveler cards, resin batch tracking, autoclave logs, and mandatory quality gates for high-mix composites. Plain markdown: https://ignisailabs.com/industries/composites-and-fiber-moulding.md

## Real-World Case Studies

- [PRC in Composites Plant](https://ignisailabs.com/case-studies/production-routing-chart): Paperless traveler cards and live WIP tracking across multi-stage moulding.
- [WMS in Industrial Distribution](https://ignisailabs.com/case-studies/warehouse-management-system): 99.8% bin accuracy and barcode-guided wave picking with SAP sync.
- [Automated Customs & Export Workflow](https://ignisailabs.com/case-studies/import-export-workflow-handler): Document packet generation under 2 minutes and container milestone tracking.
- [All Case Studies](https://ignisailabs.com/case-studies): Directory of live client deployments.
